title: Fictional defendant and capacity map

parent.objective: Maintain a source-pinned, defendant-by-defendant map for the fictional Doe v. Officer Alpha matter, each defendant analyzed only in the capacities its kind permits.
parent.milestone: Defendant identities and roles declared and one role checked against a primary source

goal: Declare each fictional defendant separately with its role and capacities, and check Officer Alpha's role against the fictional roster.
non_goals: Predict the outcome of any claim or defense.
File, serve, or send anything to any person or court.

allowed: Declare defendants, roles and capacities from the fictional complaint.
Record a primary-source check of the fictional roster.
prohibited: Cite a real statute, case, party, or authority.
Treat an allegation as fact before a bound primary-source review.
Merge two defendants or capacities into one entry.

inputs.name: Fictional complaint
inputs.description: Names Officer Alpha, Director Beta and the Town of Gamma as defendants. Fictional; establishes nothing.

outputs.name: Defendant map
outputs.description: One entry per defendant with its role, kind, capacities and sourced identity assertions.

interface.name: fictional_defendant_map
interface.description: Input the complaint; output the defendant/capacity map.

assumptions: Every defendant, role and record here is invented for this worked example.

sources.reference: Fictional complaint in the synthetic matter Plaintiff Doe v. Officer Alpha et al. (illustrative only; no such filing exists)
sources.authority: The fictional plaintiff's own allegations; not independently established.

sources.reference: Fictional Town of Gamma 2026 personnel roster (illustrative only; no such record exists)
sources.authority: Would be an official personnel record if real; a synthetic placeholder here.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each defendant appears once, and an entity is analyzed only in entity capacity.
Officer Alpha's alleged role is checked against the fictional roster by a non-implementer.

validation.description: Check defendant ids are unique and each capacity fits the defendant's kind.

argv: rows = [('DEF-ALPHA', 'natural_person', ['individual', 'official']), ('DEF-BETA', 'natural_person', ['official']), ('DEF-GAMMA', 'entity', ['entity'])]; assert len({r[0] for r in rows}) == 3; assert all((kind == 'entity') == (caps == ['entity']) for _, kind, caps in rows); print('defendant map consistent')

validation.description: A non-implementer reads the fictional roster and records whether it supports Officer Alpha's alleged role.
evidence_required: A source verification record binding the roster review, its outcome and the reviewing operator.

context_scope: This contract and its declared fictional sources.
The derived claim or defendant matrix.
architecture_boundaries: Keep each claim tied to exactly one defendant and one capacity.
Make no legal determination and perform no external writes.

domain.forum: Fictional Synthetic District Court; forum label only, no jurisdiction determination.
domain.procedural_posture: Fictional pre-filing research; no proceeding has been commenced.

defendants.role: Patrol officer alleged to have conducted the fictional 2026-01-10 stop.
Director of the fictional Gamma Licensing Office alleged to have revoked the plaintiff's license.

assertions.assertion: Officer Alpha was an on-duty Town of Gamma patrol officer during the fictional 2026-01-10 stop.
Director Beta directed the fictional Gamma Licensing Office on 2026-02-01.
The fictional Town of Gamma employed Officer Alpha on 2026-01-10.
